steps: Pick up a Pal Sphere from the starting area or craft one with Paldium Fragments and Wood.
Throw the sphere at any wild Pal to capture it.
Capture 10 unique Pal species — duplicates don't count.
Explore the starting areas around the Plateau of Beginnings for variety.
Continue exploring and capturing unique Pal species.
Venture into forests and coastlines for new types.
Explore multiple biomes — forest, desert, volcano, snow — to find unique species.
Use the Paldeck to track which species you're missing.
Craft better spheres (Mega, Giga) to capture higher-level Pals.
You'll need to visit every biome and explore dungeons for rare species.
Night-only and weather-specific Pals exist — check different times of day.
Some Pals are only obtainable through breeding.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Use the interactive map at palworld.gg to locate specific species you're missing.

steps: This requires capturing the vast majority of Pal species in the game.
You'll need access to endgame areas including Sakurajima and Feybreak regions.
Breed fusion Pals and capture legendaries to fill out your Paldeck.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Many rare Pals only spawn in specific dungeons or at specific times. Cross-reference the Paldeck with the wiki for exact locations.

steps: Capture 1000 total Pals (any species, duplicates count).
Focus on low-level Pals in high-density areas for speed.
Set up a Pal Sphere factory at your base for a steady supply.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The area around the starting plateau is great for mass captures. Lamballs and Cattivas spawn in huge numbers.
Reddit tip: Capturing gives bonus XP for the first 10 of each species, so try new species first.

steps: Weaken any human NPC (merchant, guard, wanderer) in combat.
Throw a Pal Sphere at the weakened human to capture them.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Capturing humans gives a wanted level. Do this at a remote location to avoid trouble.
Reddit tip: Merchants are easy targets — lure them away from settlements first.
warnings: Capturing humans raises your wanted level. Be prepared to evade or fight PIDF guards.

steps: Travel to the Rayne Syndicate Tower on the plateau (Tower of the Rayne Syndicate).
Defeat the boss duo Zoe & Grizzbolt. Recommended level: 15+.
Bring Ice-type Pals for an elemental advantage against Grizzbolt (Electric).
Travel to the Tower of the Free Pal Alliance in the forest biome.
Defeat Lily & Lyleen. Recommended level: 25+.
Bring Fire-type Pals for advantage against Lyleen (Grass).
Travel to the Tower of the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre in the desert.
Defeat Marcus & Faleris. Recommended level: 35+.
Bring Water-type Pals for advantage against Faleris (Fire).
Travel to the Tower of the PIDF in the volcanic region.
Defeat Axel & Orserk. Recommended level: 40+.
Bring Ground-type Pals to counter Orserk (Electric/Dragon).
Travel to the PAL Genetic Research Unit Tower in the snowy mountains.
Defeat Victor & Shadowbeak. Recommended level: 48+.
Bring Dragon-type Pals for the fight. Stock up on healing items.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the hardest base-game tower boss. Max out your best Pals and bring a full team of 5.

steps: Travel to the tower in the Sakurajima region.
Defeat Saya & Selyne. Recommended level: 45+.
Travel to the tower in the Feybreak region.
Defeat Bjorn & Bastigor. Recommended level: 50+.
This is one of the hardest tower bosses — bring your strongest team.
Travel to the tower in the Sunreach region (1.0 content).
Defeat Auri & Shaolong. Recommended level: 50+.
Jetragon spawns at the volcanic area on the western edge of the map (coordinates ~-790, -320).
It is a level 50 legendary — bring your strongest team and Legendary Spheres.
Weaken it significantly before attempting capture. Ice-type moves are effective.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Jetragon is the fastest flying mount in the game. Absolutely worth the effort to capture.
Reddit tip: Save before the fight. Legendary Spheres have low capture rates even on weakened legendaries.

steps: Paladius roams in the snowy mountain region near the northern part of the map.
It is a level 50 legendary. Bring Dark-type Pals for advantage.
Use Legendary Spheres for the best capture rate.
Necromus roams in the desert region near the southeastern part of the map.
It is a level 50 legendary. Bring Dragon-type Pals.
Use Legendary Spheres. Save before attempting capture.
Frostallion spawns in the far northwest snowy region of the map.
It is a level 50 legendary. Bring Fire-type Pals for advantage.
Use Legendary Spheres and save before the fight.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Frostallion is one of the best flying mounts. Capturing it is a priority for endgame mobility.

steps: Panthalus is a legendary ocean Pal added in the 1.0 update.
It spawns in deep ocean areas. You'll need a water mount to reach it.
Use Legendary Spheres and bring Electric-type Pals.
Build a Summoning Altar at your base.
Use Bellanoir Slabs (4 required) to summon Bellanoir.
Defeat Bellanoir in the raid, then capture it with spheres.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Bellanoir Slabs drop from dungeon bosses. Farm dungeons to stock up before attempting the raid.

steps: Build a Summoning Altar and use Bellanoir Libero Slabs (4 required).
Bellanoir Libero is significantly harder than regular Bellanoir — bring a full squad of max-level Pals.
Defeat it to unlock the achievement (capture optional).
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Do this in co-op if possible. Solo is very difficult without optimized Pals.

steps: Use the Summoning Altar with Blazamut Ryu Slabs to summon this raid boss.
Bring Water-type Pals and a full team of high-level combatants.
This is an endgame raid boss — co-op recommended.
Summon Xenolord using the Summoning Altar with appropriate slabs.
This is an extremely tough raid boss from the Feybreak update.
Bring your absolute best team. Co-op strongly recommended.
Summon Hartalis using the Summoning Altar with Hartalis Slabs.
This is a tough raid boss added in the Home Sweet Home update.
Bring a diverse team to handle its moveset.
Predator Pals are special aggressive variants that appear in the wild with a red aura.
They are tougher than normal Pals. Engage with a strong team and defeat one.
The Attack Chopper is a rare enemy encounter that can appear during PIDF raids on your base.
Alternatively, it can spawn during endgame content.
Use ranged weapons and Flying-type Pals to bring it down.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The chopper is very tanky. Rocket launchers and high-level Pals with ranged attacks are essential.

steps: Astralym is the final boss of the 1.0 story, found inside the World Tree.
You must progress the full story and reach the World Tree first.
Bring your absolute best team — this is the hardest fight in the game.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Max out your Pals' ranks and bring a variety of types. The boss has multiple phases.
warnings: This is the final story boss. Make sure you're fully prepared before entering the World Tree.

achievements.name: To the World Tree
achievements.description: Set foot within the World Tree.

steps: Progress through the main story until the World Tree becomes accessible.
Travel to and enter the World Tree area.

achievements.name: Champion of the Palpagos Islands
achievements.description: Defeat 6 tower bosses in Hard Mode.

steps: After clearing all tower bosses on Normal, Hard Mode becomes available.
Defeat all 6 tower bosses again on Hard Mode difficulty.
Hard Mode bosses have significantly more HP and hit harder — bring max-rank Pals.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Hard Mode tower bosses are no joke. Focus on elemental advantages and bring full teams of condensed Pals.

steps: Explore the map and discover named locations.
Fast Travel points and landmarks count as discoveries.
Continue exploring — visit new biomes, dungeons, and landmarks.
Check the map for undiscovered fast travel points.
Discover 70 unique named locations across the entire map.
Use flying mounts to reach remote islands and mountain peaks.
Some areas only become accessible as you level up and progress the story.
Find an enemy faction base on the map (marked with red icons).
Defeat all enemies inside to clear the base.
Clear 10 different enemy faction bases across the map.
Bases respawn after a while, but you need unique base clears.
Travel to the Oil Rig located in the ocean (northeast of the map).
You'll need a flying or swimming mount to reach it.
Clear all enemies inside the Oil Rig to seize it. Recommended level: 40+.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Oil Rig has tough PIDF soldiers and turrets. Bring strong combat Pals and good weapons.

steps: Dungeons are marked as cave entrances on the map.
Enter and defeat the boss at the end to count as cleared.
Clear 20 total dungeons — the same dungeon entrance can respawn with a new layout.
Build multiple Furnaces or Improved Furnaces at your base.
Assign Pals with Kindling work suitability to automate smelting.
Mine ore and feed it into furnaces — this total is cumulative across your entire playthrough.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Set up an automated mining + smelting pipeline. Pals with Mining and Kindling skills keep it running AFK.

steps: Craft any type of Pal Sphere — basic spheres count and are cheapest.
Use a Sphere Assembly Line with Pals assigned for automation.
This is cumulative — you'll naturally reach it while playing.
Craft ammunition at a Weapons Assembly Line.
Assign Pals with Handiwork to automate production.
Basic ammo is cheapest to mass produce. This is cumulative across your playthrough.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Coarse Ammo is the cheapest. Set up an assembly line and let it run while you do other things.

achievements.name: All for One
achievements.description: Maximized the rank of a Pal.

steps: Condense (rank up) a Pal by feeding it 4 copies of itself at the Condenser.
Each condensation requires one duplicate. Max rank needs 4 total condensations.
Farm or breed duplicates of a common Pal for the easiest path.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Lamballs are the easiest to max rank — they're everywhere and breed fast.

steps: Max the rank of 5 different Pal species via the Condenser.
Each Pal needs 4 duplicates condensed, so you need 20 duplicates total (5 species × 4 each).
Focus on common Pals and set up breeding farms.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Breed a ton of common Pals like Lamball, Cattiva, Chikipi. Use a large breeding farm setup for efficiency.

achievements.name: Best Friends Forever
achievements.description: Reached Trust level 10 with a Pal.

steps: Keep a Pal in your active party and use it frequently in combat.
Feed and pet your Pals to increase trust.
Trust increases over time as you adventure with a Pal — be patient.

achievements.name: Meddling With Mutation
achievements.description: Mutated a Pal for the first time.

steps: Mutations are a 1.0 feature. Build the Mutation Station at your base.
Use the required materials and a Pal to perform a mutation.

achievements.name: Hidden Potential
achievements.description: Awakened a Pal for the first time.

steps: Awakening is a 1.0 feature. Build the Awakening Station.
Use the required materials and a Pal to perform an awakening.
Access the Pal Labor Research menu from your base.
Complete 10 research projects by assigning Pals to tasks.
Continue completing Pal Labor Research projects.
Some projects require specific Pal types or higher-level facilities.
Complete 70 Pal Labor Research projects — this requires significant base development.
Upgrade facilities and unlock new research tiers as you progress.
Build the Expedition Board at your base.
Send Pals on 10 expeditions. They'll return with materials and loot.
Continue sending Pals on expeditions until you reach 20 total.
Use the Expedition Board regularly — expeditions complete over time.
Build a Fishing Rod and fish at any body of water.
Reel in 10 Pals through fishing.
Continue fishing to reel in 30 total Pals.
Different fishing spots yield different Pal species.
Fish at various locations until you've reeled in 50 Pals total.
Upgrade your fishing rod for better results at higher-level spots.
Lunkers are rare, large catches when fishing.
Use high-quality fishing rods and fish at premium spots for better chances.
When you hook a Lunker, the fishing minigame is harder — pay close attention.

achievements.name: Silver Champ
achievements.description: Reached Silver Rank in the Arena.

steps: Access the Arena through the Arena NPC.
Win Arena battles to increase your rank to Silver.

achievements.name: Arena Champion
achievements.description: Reached Master Rank in the Arena.

steps: Continue winning Arena battles past Silver and Gold ranks.
Reaching Master requires a strong, well-composed team of Pals.

achievements.name: Arena Legend
achievements.description: Reached Legend rank in the Arena.

steps: Push past Master rank to reach the highest Arena rank: Legend.
You'll need optimized Pals with max condensation and perfect skills.
Study opponent team compositions and counter them.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Arena Legend is the rarest achievement in the game (0.4%). You need perfectly built Pals with ideal passive skills.
warnings: This is the hardest achievement in the game. Requires deep knowledge of Pal team building and combat mechanics.

steps: Pal Bounty Tokens are earned by defeating bounty target Pals.
Check bounty boards at settlements for available targets.
Collect 5 tokens total.
Continue completing bounties until you've collected 20 Pal Bounty Tokens.
Higher-difficulty bounties may give more tokens.
Treasure Maps drop from enemies and chests.
Open a Treasure Map from your inventory to reveal a dig location.
Travel to the marked spot and dig up the treasure. Do this 5 times.
Notes are collectible lore items scattered across the map.
They glow and are found near landmarks, ruins, and camps.
Collect 40 total — use an interactive map to locate them all.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Many notes are well-hidden. Use palworld.gg interactive map to find all note locations.

steps: Lifmunk Effigies are green glowing statues scattered across the world.
Collect 50 of them — they're often on rooftops, cliffs, and treetops.
Turn them in at a Statue of Power to increase your capture rate.
Collect 100 Lifmunk Effigies across the entire map.
Use a flying mount to systematically sweep each region.
An interactive map is almost essential for finding them all.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: There are over 100 effigies in the world. Fly low and slow over each area — they glow green at night.

steps: Lamball Effigies are collectibles found in the Forest region (1.0 content).
Collect 20 of them throughout the area.
Use an interactive map for locations.
Pengullet Effigies are collectibles in the Volcano region.
Collect 20. Bring heat-resistant armor for the volcanic area.
Munchill Effigies are collectibles in the Desert region.
Collect 20. Bring heat-resistant gear.
Rooby Effigies are collectibles in the Snowy Mountain region.
Collect 20. Bring cold-resistant armor.
Herbil Effigies are collectibles in the Sakurajima region.
Collect 20 throughout the island.
Tanzee Effigies are collectibles in the Feybreak region.
Collect 20 throughout the area.
Depresso Effigies are collectibles in the Sunreach region.
Collect 20 throughout the area.
Cattiva Effigies are collectibles in the World Tree region.
Collect 20 throughout the area.
Lunaris Effigies are rare collectibles in the Forest region.
Find and collect 4 of them.
Relaxaurus Effigies are rare collectibles found on islands.
You'll need a flying mount to reach some of the island locations.
Find and collect 4 of them.
Yakumo Effigies are rare collectibles scattered across the world.
Find and collect 4 of them.
